scripts.build:packages: yarn workspace @fast-drive/auth build && yarn workspace @fast-drive/file-models build && yarn workspace @fast-drive/shared-types build
scripts.build: yarn build:packages && yarn --cwd backend build && yarn --cwd frontend build
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -k -n auth,file-models,shared-types "yarn workspace @fast-drive/auth dev" "yarn workspace @fast-drive/file-models dev" "yarn workspace @fast-drive/shared-types dev"
scripts.dev: yarn build:packages && concurrently -k -n packages,backend,frontend "yarn dev:packages" "yarn --cwd backend start:dev" "yarn --cwd frontend start"
scripts.test: yarn build:packages && yarn --cwd backend test && yarn --cwd frontend test --watch=false
